title: Streaming /v1/chat/stream (Vercel AI SDK v5 UI Message Stream)
description:
## Parent PRD

Epic convfinqa-tvq

## What to build

Add the streaming endpoint that consumes the SAME SendMessageUseCase.stream() generator as the sync endpoint, mapping each StreamEvent to a Vercel AI SDK v5 UI Message Stream SSE frame.

Includes:
- POST /v1/chat/stream returning StreamingResponse(media_type='text/event-stream') with response headers x-vercel-ai-ui-message-stream: v1, Cache-Control: no-cache, Connection: keep-alive.
- Frame mapping per PRD wire contracts: start, data-conversation, text-start, text-delta*, text-end, finish, [DONE]; on error emit data: {"type":"error","errorText":"..."} then [DONE].
- Refactor sync_chat to consume the same generator (proves no-drift abstraction).
- Streaming tests via httpx.AsyncClient + asgi-lifespan LifespanManager.
- Tests: happy-path frame ordering, mid-stream LLM error -> error frame + [DONE] + INTERRUPTED in DB, client disconnect mid-stream -> INTERRUPTED in DB, response headers presence, provider-portability smoke (Gemini-shaped fake chunks).

## User stories addressed

2, 4, 7, 8, 12
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] curl --no-buffer -X POST /v1/chat/stream emits start, data-conversation, text-start, >=1 text-delta, text-end, finish, [DONE]
- [ ] Response headers include text/event-stream and x-vercel-ai-ui-message-stream: v1
- [ ] data-conversation.data.conversationId matches a row that persists in DB
- [ ] LLM mid-stream error emits error frame + [DONE]; DB has assistant msg with stop_reason=INTERRUPTED
- [ ] Client disconnect mid-stream persists assistant msg with stop_reason=INTERRUPTED
- [ ] Sync /v1/chat still passes (uses the same generator now)
- [ ] Provider-portability smoke test passes with Gemini-shaped fake chunks

title: Foundation + sync /v1/chat (Postgres tracer bullet)
description:
## Parent PRD

Epic convfinqa-tvq

## What to build

End-to-end tracer bullet for the synchronous chat path. After this slice, `curl -X POST /v1/chat -H 'X-User-Id: dev' -d '{"message":"hi"}'` returns Anthropic-shaped JSON and persists user+assistant rows to Postgres.

Includes:
- Pyproject deps: sqlalchemy[asyncio]>=2.0, asyncpg>=0.30, alembic>=1.13, httpx==0.28.1, python-json-logger==4.1.0, dev: testcontainers[postgresql]>=4, asgi-lifespan>=2.
- docker-compose.yml with postgres service.
- .env.example: LLM_MODEL, SYSTEM_PROMPT, DATABASE_URL, AWS_PROFILE, AWS_REGION.
- Settings extended (llm_model, system_prompt, database_url).
- src/convfinqa/logging.py with python-json-logger configure_logging().
- src/convfinqa/domain/{entities.py, value_objects.py, ports/{llm.py, repository.py}}: pure dataclasses + Protocols, no framework imports.
- src/convfinqa/adapters/persistence/sqlalchemy/{models.py, engine.py, repository.py}.
- alembic/ + alembic.ini + initial migration creating conversations + messages tables (with role CHECK and indexes).
- src/convfinqa/adapters/llm/litellm_adapter.py wrapping litellm.acompletion(stream=True, stream_options={'include_usage': True}). Maps delta + final usage chunk.
- src/convfinqa/application/use_cases/send_message.py: SendMessageUseCase.stream() async generator that persists user msg, calls LLM, buffers assistant text, persists with stop_reason on finish or INTERRUPTED on error.
- src/convfinqa/entrypoints/api/errors.py: RFC 9457 Problem model + global exception handlers that JSON-log via python-json-logger.
- src/convfinqa/entrypoints/api/chat.py: chat_router prefix=/v1, current_user_id dep extracting X-User-Id, sync_chat consumes use case generator and concatenates deltas.
- Container extended with llm, conversations, send_message; main.py wires logging + chat_router + engine disposal.
- tests/conftest.py session-scoped Postgres testcontainer + per-test transactional rollback + container override.
- tests/api/test_chat.py covering: happy path, continuation, cross-tenant 404, missing X-User-Id 401, empty message 422, LLM raises 502 with INTERRUPTED partial persist.
- tests/fakes/llm.py FakeLLMPort with scripted-chunks and raise-mid-stream modes.

## User stories addressed

1, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] uv sync installs new deps
- [ ] docker compose up -d postgres starts a healthy Postgres
- [ ] uv run alembic upgrade head creates conversations + messages tables
- [ ] curl -X POST localhost:8000/v1/chat -H 'X-User-Id: dev' -d '{"message":"hi"}' returns Anthropic-shaped JSON with conversation_id
- [ ] Continuation request with the returned conversation_id sees prior history (4 rows in DB)
- [ ] Cross-tenant request returns 404 application/problem+json
- [ ] Missing X-User-Id returns 401 application/problem+json
- [ ] Empty message returns 422
- [ ] LLM error returns 502 application/problem+json AND DB has user msg + partial assistant msg with stop_reason=INTERRUPTED
- [ ] All tests pass under uv run pytest -q tests/
- [ ] uv run pyright src tests passes
- [ ] uv run ruff check src tests passes
close_reason: sync /v1/chat tracer bullet green: 6 integration tests pass, pyright + ruff clean, alembic migration drives schema in fixture

title: Typer CLI REPL: convfinqa chat
description:
## Parent PRD

Epic convfinqa-tvq

## What to build

Interactive Typer subcommand `convfinqa chat` that streams tokens from /v1/chat/stream. Defaults --user-id to os.getenv('USER','dev-user'); default --base-url=http://localhost:8000. REPL prompt '> '. /exit or Ctrl-D leaves; /new resets conversation_id mid-session. Uses httpx.AsyncClient.stream('POST', ...) and parses 'data: ...\n\n' SSE frames; dispatches by type; prints text-delta with flush=True; captures data-conversation.data.conversationId.

Includes:
- src/convfinqa/entrypoints/cli/app.py with Typer app + chat subcommand.
- pyproject [project.scripts] convfinqa = convfinqa.entrypoints.cli.app:app (or similar).
- tests/cli/test_smoke.py: convfinqa chat --help exits 0.

## User stories addressed

3, 19, 20
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] uv run convfinqa chat --help exits 0 and shows --user-id/--base-url/--system flags
- [ ] uv run convfinqa chat --user-id me starts a REPL with '> ' prompt
- [ ] Typed message streams token deltas to terminal (flushed)
- [ ] /new resets conversation_id; subsequent message creates a fresh conversation
- [ ] /exit and Ctrl-D both leave cleanly
- [ ] DB shows distinct conversation_ids before and after /new

title: Concurrent-request 409 lock (pg advisory)
description:
## Parent PRD

Epic convfinqa-tvq

## What to build

Prevent two in-flight requests on the same conversation_id from interleaving via Postgres advisory lock with try-acquire semantics. If busy, return 409 application/problem+json with type https://convfinqa.local/problems/conversation-busy (sync) or domain ConcurrentRequest event mapped to 409 (stream).

Includes:
- In SendMessageUseCase.stream(), after persisting the user message and before the LLM call, open a transaction and call pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(conversation_id, 0)). On false -> yield ConcurrentRequest event.
- API maps ConcurrentRequest to 409 problem-details body in BOTH sync and stream presenters.
- The user message is persisted OUTSIDE this lock (its own transaction) so input is preserved even if a concurrent attempt is rejected.
- Test: two concurrent /v1/chat/stream requests against the same conversation_id; the first holds the LLM open via FakeLLMPort blocking primitive; the second returns 409.

## User stories addressed

(supports cross-cutting concurrency safety for stories 5, 6 — server-stateful integrity)
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Two parallel POST /v1/chat/stream against the same conversation_id: second returns 409
- [ ] 409 body is application/problem+json with type=conversation-busy and status=409
- [ ] User message of the rejected attempt is NOT persisted (lock check happens after first user-msg persist of the holding request, but new arrival's user msg... clarify: per PRD, user msg persisted outside lock means each attempt's user msg lands; verify behavior matches PRD wording)
- [ ] Lock auto-releases on transaction commit/rollback (no leak on crash)
- [ ] Test simulates worker crash mid-lock and verifies next request succeeds
